inputs.original_text: The DMK's new manifesto, unveiled by Chief Minister M.K. Stalin, promises significant welfare boosts, including doubling women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000 and offering Rs 8,000 household coupons. Farmers will receive free motor pumpsets. The party also aims for substantial FDI growth and job creation, as well as enhanced support for fishermen and a focus on AI development.
inputs.modified_text: The DMK's new manifesto was unveiled by Chief Minister M.K. Stalin.
